pctwet2019ws=Accepted by the owner (2026-09-08) as a flagged curve under methodology 0.11 rule SELECT-03: a function is covered when its curve is one DEEP can interpolate, and this three-point fallback does interpolate and score, so Surface water storage is scored rather than recorded as a gap. The evidence and the cost: the wadeable Interior Plateau reference pool carries very little mapped wetland, 11 of 38 retained sites exactly zero, a median of 0.05 percent of watershed area and a maximum of 5.93, so the lower quartile is zero and the seed falls back to a three-point shape. Ratings on this curve therefore turn on small differences in mapped wetland near zero, below the land cover product's own wetland-class accuracy, and the curve publishes with that caveat attached to it. This is a property of the wadeable pool rather than of the combined wetland column: combined cover is woody plus herbaceous, so it is at least woody at every site, and woody alone is degenerate in the same pool. The alternative considered and declined was recording Surface water storage as data-unavailable and publishing with 19 of 20 functions covered.
USEPA NRSA (L3 ecoregion 71), StreamCurves Regional Analysis Agent

items.subject: reference_screen

review_flags: REF-02 fallback: only 0 Functioning sites, below the exploratory floor of 10; included Functioning-at-Risk to reach 39. Mandatory review; confidence capped; reference tier = best_available.

items.question: The least-disturbed pool is below the exploratory floor. Accept the best-available reference for this ecoregion under mandatory review, or stop and acquire more least-disturbed sites?
items.reviewer_rationale: Best-available reference accepted for this region under standing decision ref02-accept-best-available (policy 1.0), enabled by the owner for this run. The least-disturbed pool is below the DATA-05 exploratory floor, so the fallback fired as designed, every curve publishes capped at Low with the tier stamped on the bundle and on every metric entry, and the retained pool of 39 sites describes the region's typical remaining streams rather than a selective reference. The 0.39 cutoff stays provisional.

items.subject: bent_TOTLNTAX
items.question: One site moves this curve past the influence threshold. Keep the site, investigate it, or accept the curve with the flag?
items.reviewer_rationale: Accepted with the flag under standing decision curve04-accept-with-flag (policy 1.0), expanded from this record's own evidence. For this curve: no decision flip (the build validates with or without the site); the largest drop-one shift is 41 percent of a seed parameter (0.44 IQR), driven by site ILSS-1118. Drop-one quartile sensitivity is inherent to a reference pool of this size on a skewed distribution, the driver is a valid reference site, and removal without a data-quality reason is prohibited. The curve carries the mandatory-review cap until this decision is on the record.
